title: Engineering of the Lrp/AsnC-type transcriptional regulator DecR as a genetically encoded biosensor for multilevel optimization of L-cysteine biosynthesis pathway in Escherichia coli.
authors: Zhou, Zhiyou; Li, Zonglin; Zhong, Yahui; Xu, Shuai; Li, Zhimin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过蛋白工程改造转录调控因子DecR构建L-半胱氨酸生物传感器，并用MD模拟和EMSA研究其与DNA结合增强机制，属于TF-DNA互作相关但侧重生物合成应用，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: L-cysteine is an important sulfur-containing amino acid being difficult to produce by microbial fermentation. Due to the lack of high-throughput screening methods, existing genetically engineered bacteria have been developed by simply optimizing the expression of L-cysteine-related genes one by one. To overcome this limitation, in this study, a biosensor-based approach for multilevel biosynthetic pathway optimization of L-cysteine from the DecR regulator variant of Escherichia coli was applied. Through protein engineering, we obtained the DecR(N29Y/C81E/M90Q/M99E) variant-based biosensor with improved specificity and an 8.71-fold increase in dynamic range. Using the developed biosensor, we performed high-throughput screening of the constructed promoter and RBS combination library, and successfully obtained the optimized strain, which resulted in a 6.29-fold increase in L-cysteine production. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and electrophoretic mobility shift analysis (EMSA) showed that the N29Y/C81E/M90Q/M99E variant had enhanced induction activity. This enhancement may be due to the increased binding of the variant to DNA in the presence of L-cysteine, which enhances transcriptional activation. Overall, our biosensor-based strategy provides a promising approach for optimizing biosynthetic pathways at multiple levels. The successful implementation of this strategy demonstrates its potential for screening improved recombinant strains.
abstract_zh: L-半胱氨酸是一种重要的含硫氨基酸，难以通过微生物发酵生产。由于缺乏高通量筛选方法，现有的基因工程菌仅通过逐一优化L-半胱氨酸相关基因的表达来开发。为克服这一限制，本研究应用了一种基于生物传感器的多层级生物合成途径优化方法，该方法源自大肠杆菌的DecR调节因子变体。通过蛋白质工程，我们获得了基于DecR(N29Y/C81E/M90Q/M99E)变体的生物传感器，其特异性提高，动态范围增加了8.71倍。利用所开发的生物传感器，我们对构建的启动子和RBS组合文库进行了高通量筛选，并成功获得了优化菌株，使L-半胱氨酸产量提高了6.29倍。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和电泳迁移率变动分析 (electrophoretic mobility shift analysis) 表明，N29Y/C81E/M90Q/M99E变体具有增强的诱导活性。这种增强可能归因于在L-半胱氨酸存在下，变体与DNA的结合增加，从而增强了转录激活。总体而言，我们的基于生物传感器的策略为多层级优化生物合成途径提供了一种有前景的方法。该策略的成功实施展示了其在筛选改良重组菌株方面的潜力。
